headline: Flawed EC System Leaves Valid Goa Voters Out
summary: Valid Goa voters claim they were left off the electoral rolls despite sending multiple emails to the Election Commission over a span of seven days. The issue has sparked sharp criticism of the EC's verification process.

headline: Goa Electoral Officer Clarifies on 97 Excluded Electors
summary: The Goa electoral officer addressed concerns regarding 97 electors not being included in the rolls, stating that many others were successfully added. The clarification comes amid intense scrutiny of the state's voter lists.

headline: Goa Opposition Demands Rollback of SIR Exercise
summary: Opposition parties in Goa have launched attacks against the Election Commission and the BJP over the SIR exercise. They are demanding a complete rollback of the controversial voter list revision process.

headline: Goa to Host IPL 2027 Auction
summary: The BCCI has officially confirmed that Goa will serve as the venue for the IPL 2027 auction. The high-profile cricket event is scheduled to take place in mid-December.

headline: IPL Auction Returns to India with Goa 2027 Edition
summary: After a hiatus, the IPL auction is returning to India for its 2027 edition. Goa has been chosen to host the mini-auction in December.

headline: CM Laments Outsiders Grabbing Goa Jobs and Business
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that persons from outside the state are successfully grabbing business and job opportunities while local Goans are failing to do so. He urged the youth to actively explore emerging employment avenues.

headline: Dump Mining Can Boost Goa Economy: Sawant
summary: CM Sawant expressed confidence that resuming dump mining will provide a significant boost to jobs, local businesses, and the overall economy. He encouraged the youth to capitalize on these upcoming economic prospects.

headline: AAP-GFP Alliance Faces Congress Challenge in Goa
summary: The political landscape in Goa sees new friction as the AAP-GFP alliance encounters a strong challenge from the Congress party. Opposition dynamics continue to shift ahead of upcoming political engagements.

headline: Goa Police Sign MoU on Beat Policing
summary: The Goa Police and the Bureau of Police Research and Development (BPR&D) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding. The agreement aims to strengthen and modernize beat policing across the state.

headline: Goa Launches Seva Sankalp Abhiyan for Youth Skills
summary: The Goa government has launched the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan initiative to equip youth with modern skills and artificial intelligence training. Ministers urged young residents to leverage these technological programs.

headline: Railway Attendant Arrested with Goa Liquor in Thane
summary: A railway attendant was arrested on the Mangaluru Express in Thane for carrying Goa-made liquor worth Rs 71,560. Authorities intercepted the contraband during a routine check.

headline: EC Must Clean Up After 97 Eligible Voters Kept Off Rolls
summary: Pressure is mounting on the Election Commission to provide transparency regarding 97 eligible Goa voters who were left off final electoral rolls. The controversy has triggered widespread political backlash.

headline: New Song Captures Goa's Susegad Spirit
summary: The track 'Do Guna Zindagi' from the upcoming project 'Little Thomas' has been released, capturing the laid-back susegad spirit of Goa. Artists praised the cultural resonance of the state.

headline: EC Responds to Opposition's Voter List Manipulation Charges
summary: The Election Commission has responded to allegations made by Goa opposition parties regarding voter list manipulation during the SIR row. Authorities defended the integrity of the electoral roll revision process.

headline: Goa Opposition Red-Flags 'Voter Deletion' After Report
summary: Following an investigative report, opposition parties in Goa have raised red flags over alleged systematic voter deletions. They are pressing election authorities for immediate accountability.

headline: Centre Approves Seafarers' Welfare Centre at Mormugao
summary: The central government has granted approval for the establishment of a dedicated seafarers' welfare centre at Mormugao. The facility aims to support maritime workers visiting the port.

headline: Atal Setu Entry Opens for Porvorim Traffic
summary: The entry point to the Atal Setu has been opened for Porvorim traffic to ease congestion. Chief Minister Sawant assured that a comprehensive traffic plan will be finalized within a week.

headline: Goa Liberation and Jyotiba Featured in Kolhapur Procession
summary: Themes highlighting the Goa Liberation movement and Jyotiba will be showcased on Kolhapur’s traditional visarjan route. The tableaux celebrate historical and cultural milestones.

headline: Porvorim Flyover Exit Reopened to Ease Gridlock
summary: Authorities have reopened one of the Porvorim flyover exits to mitigate severe traffic congestion around Merces and Divja Circle. Commuters had previously faced major delays in the area.

headline: KTC Explores Concessional Travel Options for Women
summary: The Kadamba Transport Corporation (KTC) is actively exploring the implementation of concessional travel schemes for women passengers. The initiative aims to enhance affordable public transit access.

headline: Boat Owners Submit Grievances Over Infrastructure Costs
summary: Local boat owners have formally submitted grievances to authorities regarding mounting infrastructure challenges and high fuel costs. They are seeking urgent financial relief and support.

headline: Rane Defends Land Conversion Figures in Goa
summary: A state minister clarified that less than 1% of land has been converted across Goa over the past four and a half years. The statement comes in response to environmental and political queries.

headline: Goa Announces Home-Based Services for Seniors
summary: The Goa government is rolling out new initiatives to provide essential home-based services for senior citizens. The program is designed to assist elderly residents with daily care needs.

headline: Konkani Prime News Bulletin Broadcast
summary: Prudent Media aired its scheduled regional Konkani news bulletin covering top stories and developments from across Goa.

headline: KTC Earns Rs 60 Lakh During Chaturthi Festive Surge
summary: The Kadamba Transport Corporation recorded a revenue of Rs 60 lakh during the busy Chaturthi festival period. Increased commuter travel during the celebrations drove the earnings.

headline: BJP Appoints Bharati Pawar as New Goa In-Charge
summary: The BJP has shuffled its state organizational charges, appointing Bharati Pawar as the new party in-charge for Goa. The leadership change is part of ongoing structural updates.

headline: Goa Pharmacies Adapt to Modern Technological Demands
summary: Local pharmacies across Goa are upgrading their operations and digital tools to keep pace with modern customer expectations and pharmaceutical delivery trends.

headline: Late September Showers Leave Goa Parched
summary: Although September showers have finally arrived, rainfall remains below average, leaving parts of Goa parched. Weather observers note a delayed monsoon retreat pattern.

headline: Kasturirangan Report Concerns Border Migration to Goa
summary: The Karnataka Assembly Deputy Speaker warned that the implementation of the Kasturirangan report could force families from Uttara Kannada to migrate to neighboring Goa.

headline: Goa Becomes First State with Adult Vaccination Policy
summary: Goa has achieved a milestone by becoming the first state in India to roll out a comprehensive adult vaccination policy. The public health initiative targets preventable diseases across adult demographics.
